queries.compiledQueryString:
WITH data AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_startups,
    SUM(turnover) AS total_turnover,
    SUM(profit) AS total_profit,
    SUM(employees_gp) AS total_employees,
    SUM(total_budget_payments) AS total_budget_payments,

    -- 2022 values for reference
    SUM(previous_turnover) AS total_previous_turnover,
    SUM(previous_profit) AS total_previous_profit,
    SUM(previous_employees_gp) AS total_previous_employees,
    SUM(previous_total_budget_payments) AS total_previous_budget_payments
  FROM
    startups.data
)
SELECT
  total_startups,
  total_turnover,
  total_profit,
  total_employees,
  total_budget_payments,

   (total_turnover - total_previous_turnover) / total_previous_turnover AS turnover_delta_percent,
  (total_profit - total_previous_profit) / total_previous_profit AS profit_delta_percent,
  (total_employees - total_previous_employees) / total_previous_employees AS employees_delta_percent,
  (total_budget_payments - total_previous_budget_payments) / total_previous_budget_payments AS budget_payments_delta_percent
FROM
  data
